review_candidates.description: Job Description Changing the world, influencing the digital future! Expect more. Connect more. Be more at Diebold Nixdorf. More than 160 years ago, we started by manufacturing safes and vaults - security is encoded in our DNA. We are pioneers in development, sales and service of ATMs, cash registers and self-checkouts, including development and supply of SW and HW. Our teams do everything possible to make shopping and paying as convenient as possible for users. We are the innovation partner for most of the financial institutions and retail chains. Together, we impact the lives of more than 75 million people worldwide. Our solutions connect the physical and digital world through cash and non-cash transaction s - quickly, securely and efficiently. The Košice branch of Diebold Nixdorf was officially opened in November 2017. We are a strategic delivery center where experts work in the areas of corporate infrastructure, application management, information security, as well as in teams dealing with IT processes. Since its beginning in Košice, the company has established itself on the local market of IT companies, we participate in job fairs, we have established cooperation with many schools and organize a lot of activities for our employees. As Systems Administrator you will provide ongoing systems administration support including installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of end-point systems. Operational responsibilities include remediation of daily incident tickets, system compliance, system run enhancement, testing, staging, policy / procedure enhancement, customer contact coordination and operational recommendations, creation of documentation. Are you ready to be part of our friendly team? Now you have the chance! WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING AS SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR? You will provide support to address availability and reliability issues on various systems (Windows, Linux) across multiple locations You will perform installation and maintenance for an assigned organization, location or line of business You will administer development, test and production servers and endpoints, including reloading, re-imaging and debugging problems You will install, remove and upgrade software packages on test, development and production servers You will troubleshoot systems and host environments, identifying and resolving faults, inconsistencies and systemic issues You will provide systems evaluation and operational reports You will maintain required compliance reports and documentation WHAT EXPERIENCE / SKILLS DO YOU NEED? You have experience in Windows systems Experience with Linux environment Experience with Active directory You have knowledge of Network You are comfortable with OS installation, administration, troubleshooting and command line PowerShell – reading scripts Bash - reading scripts You have great understanding of systems infrastructure Fluent communication in English and Slovak language NICE TO HAVE (BUT NOT NECESSARY) PowerShell scripting Bash scripting Get To Know Our Team And How We Work You'll join the team of 10 colleagues, led by Barbara Semanova, who is also participating in daily operations what gives her the opportunity to fully understand team´s needs. We are a close-knit team that values strong collaboration. We strive to align our efforts, act fairly, and work together to solve challenges while proactively proposing effective solutions . Pay Transparency Statement The monthly base salary range for this position starts from 1,575€ to 2,250€ gross. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as qualifications, skills, competencies, geographic location, and relevant experience. Certain roles may include additional components beyond base salary, such as incentive opportunities or other forms of variable compensation. Details of any such components will be discussed during the interview process and will be governed by the applicable plan documents. WHAT DO WE OFFER? Prestige – we are a Key Partner to Financial institutions and Retailers Stability & perspective - we have been on the market for many years and operate globally Great team - we maintain friendly and helpful relationships, we are not just colleagues Future career - you can become a team leader or specialize in your field, grow with us Innovation and development - we support individual development and professional training; experienced colleagues are also happy to pass on their experience Remuneration - in addition to fair wages, we have annual bonuses according to the company results Flexibility - we accommodate parents and support work-life balance. We offer flexible home office including flexible working hours Public transport - we will reimburse you for a yearly voucher for Košice MHD / Slovak Bus Lines (AD) / Slovak Railway Transport Time off - 5 weeks holiday + 3 sick days + bridge days Equipment - of course you get a laptop and phone including unlimited tariff and data Cafeteria - you choose your own benefits; we will give you generous budget per year to your cafeteria account Meal vouchers – you get your meal allowance from day one MultiSport - we support the physical and mental health of our colleagues The future – we contribute to your pension insurance (III.pilar) Allowance for working from home – we contribute monthly to your home internet or electricity Good thing – we give you 2 days of paid time off for volunteering Modern offices – relax zones, gym equipment, video games and great workspace with view on the city Our success is never a job for one person! We look forward to you joining our team. Don't miss the opportunity to become one of us! More About Us Why should you join Diebold Nixdorf? Brightest minds + technology and innovation + business transformation We have 23 000+ great colleagues in 130+ countries around the world creating technologies of the future, together. Our culture is fueled by our values of collaboration, decisiveness, urgency, willingness to change, and accountability. Supportive company culture combined with internal training and technological facilities creates ideal conditions for professional development of each employee, meaningful and responsible work focused on the daily needs of our customers and, last but not least, opportunity to balance personal and professional life. *Diebold Nixdorf is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. * ** To all recruitment agencies: Diebold Nixdorf does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Diebold Nixdorf employees or any other organization location. Diebold Nixdorf is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. ** We are a global company operating in multiple locations and entities. As we are keen to find the best solution for our candidates several legal entities might be applicable for a Job offer. A List of our operating entities can be found here - https://www.dieboldnixdorf.com/en-us/about-us/global-locations

review_candidates.title: Administrador/a de Redes – Fortinet. HIBRIDO- MADRID/ RESTO DE ESPAÑA-REMOTO (ID)
review_candidates.description: ¿Tienes experiencia administrando infraestructuras de red y especialización en Fortinet? En Abalia buscamos incorporar un/a Administrador/a de Redes para participar en un proyecto estable, trabajando con tecnologías de seguridad y networking avanzadas. 🚀 ¿Cuál será tu misión? Te incorporarás a un equipo responsable de la administración, evolución y seguridad de una infraestructura de red basada principalmente en tecnologías Fortinet . Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán: Administrar, configurar y mantener firewalls FortiGate , incluyendo políticas, reglas, NAT y VPN IPsec/SSL. Gestionar la infraestructura de forma centralizada mediante FortiManager y FortiAnalyzer . Administrar FortiSwitch, FortiAP y FortiNAC , dentro de la arquitectura Fortinet Security Fabric . Gestionar la segmentación de red, VLANs, routing estático y BGP , así como las políticas de acceso. Ejecutar actualizaciones de firmware, parches de seguridad y tareas de gestión del ciclo de vida de los equipos. Documentar configuraciones, topologías de red y procedimientos operativos. Dar soporte y resolver incidencias relacionadas con la red y la seguridad perimetral. Participar en la identificación e implementación de mejoras continuas en la arquitectura de red. 🛠️ ¿Qué buscamos? Grado o Ingeniería en Informática, Telecomunicaciones o similar . También valoraremos experiencia equivalente demostrable. Al menos 4 años de experiencia demostrable trabajando con tecnologías Fortinet . Experiencia con FortiGate imprescindible. ·         FortiGate: configuración avanzada de firewall policies, VPN, NAT y HA/clustering. ·         FortiManager y FortiAnalyzer . ·         FortiSwitch, FortiAP y FortiNAC . ·        Arquitectura Fortinet Security Fabric . ·        Protocolos y tecnologías de red: TCP/IP, VLAN, DNS, DHCP y BGP . ·        VPN site-to-site y client-to-site , mediante IPsec/SSL. RESIDENCIA ACTUAL, LEGAL Y PRMISO DE TRABAJO VIGENTE EN ESPAÑA. Valorable : Experiencia con otros fabricantes como Cisco, Check Point o Forcepoint . Conocimientos de networking y seguridad en Azure, AWS o Google Cloud .   🤝 ¿Qué valoramos? Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas . Buena comunicación y capacidad para elaborar documentación técnica . Interés por aprender y trabajar con nuevas tecnologías de networking y seguridad. Capacidad de trabajo en equipo. Disponibilidad para realizar intervenciones fuera de horario , cuando las necesidades del servicio lo requieran.   ¿Qué ofrecemos? Contrato indefinido. Si resides en Madrid, se requiere 1 día presencial en oficina . Si estás fuera de Madrid, también valoramos tu candidatura si tu perfil encaja con el proyecto, para trabajar desde España. Jornada completa. Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada 22 días laborables de vacaciones.   🌟 ¿Qué encontrarás? Un proyecto en el que podrás trabajar con tecnologías Fortinet de forma avanzada, participar en la evolución de una infraestructura de red y aportar tu experiencia en networking, seguridad y mejora continua . Si eres especialista en Fortinet y buscas un nuevo reto, ¡queremos conocerte!   Si te encuentras en búsqueda de nuevos retos y proyectos innovadores. Abalia ¡Es tu lugar! Inscríbete en nuestra oferta, y anímate a trabajar de una manera diferente. En Abalia, nuestro eslogan «El lado humano de la tecnología» pone de manifiesto lo que ofrecemos tanto al cliente externo como interno, y es que las personas siempre están en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Cuidamos cada detalle, evolucionamos con los años, y nos adaptamos a los cambios para ofrecer lo mejor a nuestros colaboradores, clientes y empleados. ¿Qué buscamos? Personas con talento, entusiastas, con ganas de aprender y enganchadas a la tecnología. Si te sientes identificado estaremos encantados de que te unas a nuestra gran familia de Abalia. ¿Por qué elegirnos? Porque somos diferentes, por tres motivos principales: 1.- Para nosotros las personas son lo importante. 2.- Porque apostamos por la innovación y el aprendizaje continuo. 3.- Aportamos nuestro granito de arena para mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas, mediante la tecnología y proyectos que hacen de este mundo un lugar mejor

review_candidates.title: Associate Director of Network Engineering
review_candidates.description: Feel Good About Doing Good The Knights of Columbus is a tax-exempt Catholic fraternal benefit society that provides financial security to members and their families through our life insurance, long-term care insurance, disability income insurance, investment and annuity products. Charity is at the core of our missions: our profits are donated to help those in need and to support our faith - $1.73B over the past ten years. While we have many employees who are not Catholic, we follow the Church’s teachings in our investment strategies and our employee benefits. As part of our religious mission, we support the pro-life cause by contributing to the March for Life and pregnancy resource centers, we oppose assisted suicide and euthanasia, we are evangelists for the Catholic faith, and we help Christians who are facing religious persecution in the Middle East. We all work together to support our two million members as they volunteer to help others in their parishes and communities around the world. Share Your Talent. Live Your Purpose. We are a growing and purpose-driven community of professionals. Join us to discover how you can meet your goals and ours! Overview The Associate Director of Network Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, and support of the enterprise-wide network infrastructure. This individual will lead a team of network engineers while actively participating in the planning, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of network technologies. The role requires deep expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, VPN’s, wireless, and cloud networking, as well as strong leadership and project management skills. Core Responsibilities Lead and manage day-to-day operations of the network engineering team, providing technical guidance and mentoring Design, configure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, firewalls, VPNs, switches, wireless systems, and UCaaS/CCaaS systems Serve as an escalation point for complex network issues, participating in troubleshooting and root cause analysis Implement and maintain network monitoring and performance tuning tools to ensure high availability and reliability Oversee network security in collaboration with the cybersecurity team, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures Manage lifecycle upgrades for switches, routers, firewalls, and other networking hardware Participate in the architecture and implementation of hybrid cloud network environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Coud) Collaborate with application, server, and security teams to ensure seamless end-to-end infrastructure support Develop and maintain documentation and network diagrams Manage vender relationships and coordinate support for hardware and software issues Lead network-related projects including office expansions, data center migrations, and cloud integrations Skills Qualifications Strong working knowledge of enterprise networking technologies (Cisco, Fortinet, Aruba, Meraki, Arista, Azure Cloud Networking, etc.) Experience in routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, QoS, VLANs, STP) Experience with firewalls, VPNs, and Zero trust security models Experience with Cloud Networking (Azure ExpressRoute, Azure Firewalls, VPN Gateways, Azure BGP, Virtual WAN HUB, VNET Subnetting, etc.) Experience with network automation, scripting, and monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Logic Monitor, etc.) Skilled at working within a team-oriented, collaborative environment Strong Analytical and problem-solving skills Experience with Cloud Based UCaaS/CCaaS Systems Education BS or BA in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field or equivalent combination of experience and training 12+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, with at least 3 to 5 years in a leadership or supervisory role Compensation Data The wage range for this role takes into account a broad array of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to: skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The range below applies as long as the work is performed in Connecticut; the Knights of Columbus reserves the right to adjust the wage range if the position is performed in another location. At the Knights of Columbus, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $135,000-$229,500. Physical Demands Must be able to remain in a stationary position for a majority of the workday. Ability to travel as needed KofC Cares Our mission is focused on family and faith, and we support our employees in seeking a balanced life. Employee benefits include: Time Away: 13 paid holidays per year in addition to vacation and paid sick leave, and flexible workweek schedules. Professional Development: Certifications, designation, and tuition reimbursement. Retirement Benefits: 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching company contributions, and cash balance retirement plans fully funded by the company. Health and Wellness: Short-term disability and term life insurance fully paid for by the company; Up to 12 weeks of childbirth leave under STD policy. One week of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoptive and foster parents. A variety of health insurance options, including premium-level family coverage and a pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions. The Order's health plans do not cover abortion, sterilization, or contraception, and the Order has helped advocate for other employers who do not want to provide coverage. Long-term disability insurance; Dental insurance; Vision insurance; Health club membership reimbursement; Employee Assistance Program
